case: BaTiO3 T to C endpoint gate

vcneb_audit.input_root_cause: The endpoint file labels are reversed: T_CONTCAR is cubic (4.028225 Angstrom on each axis), while C_CONTCAR is tetragonal/polar (3.990321 x 3.990321 x 4.239804 Angstrom). The latter then relaxed to near-cubic under this CP2K contract in the completed 27-step final-endpoint BFGS run.
vcneb_audit.duplicate_probe: Job 27761267 used a VASP T POSCAR byte-identical to the already-relaxed C_CONTCAR seed with the same CP2K profile. It was cancelled after 9 minutes once the duplication was verified; its directory is preserved.
vcneb_audit.verdict: Both endpoints are essentially cubic; endpoint force/stress convergence alone does not establish a tetragonal-to-cubic transition. Exclude from production benchmark and literature barrier comparison.
